title: Char Kway Teow
description: Char Kway Teow is a dish from Malaysia prepared with rice noodles, garlic, shrimp, smoked pork loin. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Smoked pork loin stands in for Chinese lap cheong; use flat rice noodles if available.

steps.instruction: Soak the measured rice or noodles in clean cool water for about 25 minutes, then drain and proceed to the specified cooking step.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 9 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 8 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 4 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
